statement: A script test's covers manifest names every code file the test executes, so that a change to any of them selects the test and invalidates its cache.
note: The covers trace (GX-29) has reported this in every Python test since the initial tree, in report mode (gate-trace.covers_trace_mode) with no deadline; PADRAO-DEV measured 7,700 test x file pairs the gate would not run (docs/programs/padrao-dev/analise.md). PROP-covers-trace-blocking gives it a deadline.
